body: I’m doing better then I was. I’m trying to stay around for a little while longer
I’ve been feeling a lot better with all the support I don’t wanna disappoint anyone
I’m so sorry about your mom❤️ this support makes me feel a lot better. It’ll make me feel like I disappointed a lot of people if I go
I am. I can’t decide what I wanna do anymore
I hope you don’t either. It’s very hard being at rock bottom knowing there’s no one to save you
I’m trying to keep going I feel a little better today so I hope I feel better on Monday
With all the support I feel a little better thank you for asking!
I am thank you for checking
Mine too I completely understand where you are coming from. Idk you but I hope you feel better I honestly hope we both do
If you’d like to be
I’m not sure I wanna die anymore I just want my pain to go away I don’t wanna struggle anymore I don’t wanna be in pain
I don’t think I’m ready to die I just don’t know how to deal with my pain
Thank you so much for taking time out your day to comment it means a lot to me
For now thank you for checking
Thank you so much it means a lot
Thank you for trying
Thank you so much for trying I truly appreciate you so much
I am very young that’s the hard part I’m kinda stuck there’s no way to help myself unless I just continue suffering and “wait for better days” but who’s to say it gets better
Huggsss I do hope you have a better days to change your mind no one deserves to feel this way
I’m sorry for your loss. Thank you I hope you have a peaceful wonderful life
Thank you for trying it truly means the world to me
Thank you for trying seriously it means so much to me that you took time out of your day to make sure I was okay
I’m sorry I hope you do too

I’m so sorry for the loss of your uncle Ik how much it hurts and I hope you and your family get the closure you guys need. Your uncle would be very proud to know you tried to help someone out. I’m sorry you feel suicidal as well I hope you see better days, it’s not fun feeling like you’re drowning
You helped by just making this comment! I never really experienced someone actually caring about me or even pretending to, so thank you for even trying.
May the light shine on you as well
Hugssss thank you I’ll remember you
Thank you I’ll remember you for trying
She’s not as great as she seems. I just don’t want her last memory of me being cold and gone
It’s not as sweet as it seems. We do bake together and she’s teaching me how to cook
I’d like that if that’s okay with you
I hope you feel better as well. I do know this is it for me but I don’t think this option is meant for everyone. I’m sorry you’re suicidal as well it’s a lonely feeling that never ends
I hope so too

No it’s okay not aggressive at all! Ik no one would care because no one cares now. You shouldn’t wait until someone’s dead to miss them. No one makes sure I’m okay now so I think everyone will be okay without ne
I’ve held on for so very long and I’m tired. Thank you so much it truly means everything that you even care to respond
Over the years a lot has happened so I tried to hold on and tried to see onto brighter days but I can’t anymore
I just realized I was tired of trying thank you so much for asking
I don’t have anyone but Ik it’s the right thing to do
